description: Defines the AOS_InvoicesViewDetail class for rendering invoice details, including methods for populating invoice templates and displaying popup HTML for PDF generation within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for invoice detail display, handling template population and popup HTML rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays invoice details and invokes popup HTML rendering.

methods.name: populateInvoiceTemplates
methods.description: Fetches active invoice templates from database and populates a global list.

methods.name: displayPopupHtml
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript for selecting invoice templates and generating PDFs.
